definition: II. [ גְּדוּד , or גְּדוּדָה ] noun [masculine or feminine] furrow , cutting — 1. furrow , plural defective גְּדוּדֶ֑הָ Ps 65:11 (|| תְּלָמֶיהָ ). 2. plural גְּדֻדֹת , cuttings upon hands, compare גדד Hithpo`el 2. sign of mourning Jer 48:37 (|| שׂק ).

II. [גְּדוּד, or גְּדוּדָה] noun [masculine or feminine] furrow, cutting —

1. furrow, plural defective גְּדוּדֶ֑הָ Ps 65:11 (|| תְּלָמֶיהָ).
2. plural גְּדֻדֹת, cuttings upon hands, compare גדד Hithpo`el
2. sign of mourning Jer 48:37 (|| שׂק).
